fullContentHtml:
IBPS CRP PO/ MT 16th Mains Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the Mains Admit Card for the Probationary Officer / Management Trainee on its official website. This recruitment was released for 7565 posts. Applications for IBPS CRP PO/ MT 16th Pre Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 01 July 2026, to 26 July 2026. The Pre examination was conducted on 23 August 2026. Candidates who had appeared in Pre exam can download their IBPS CRP PO/ MT 16th Mains Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 July 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 26 July 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 July 2026
  • Edit Application Window : 29-30 July 2026
  • PET Admit Card (SC/ ST) : 10 August 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 23 August 2026
  • Pre Exam Admit Card : 14 August 2026
  • Pre Result : 23 September 2026
  • Pre Score Card : 29 September 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 24 September 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : October 2026
  • Mains Result : November 2026
  • Mains Score Card : November 2026
  • Personality Test : November 2026
  • Interview Letter : November 2026
  • Interview Date : November/ December 2026
  • Final Result : January 2027

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Application Correction Charge : Rs. 175/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
